trajectory.statement: Skill Engine experiments falsified q-as-quality, similarity-as-utility, greedy-as-exact, reconstruction-as-transfer, and treated small-n exact enumeration as the reference.
Capability work moved to explicit invocation, observation, evidence, provenance, and live-world laboratory semantics.
Epistemic semantics separated evidence, claims, gates, decisions, contradictions, retraction, and revision over one append-only ledger.
Relational applicability and continuation were treated as symbolic/provenance layers rather than implicit authority.
Execution assurance separates execution state, qualification, epistemic state, decision/context state, and reusable learning.
Evidence usability is temporal and contextual: integrity, scope, time validity, first-seen ordering, and claim match matter.
Fresh starts may reuse mechanisms/contracts/tests while qualification, authority, and trust require new context and evidence.
A mechanism-level online frontier shift can be measured under a matched cost contract without proving a universal computational claim.
The self-hosting operator boundary constrains discovery, planning, invocation, evidence, and completion while excluding hidden reasoning from persisted authority.
Experimental validity requires assignment/intervention/order integrity, contamination handling, and explicit assumptions.
Epistemic state is not authorization; contradiction and retraction are append-only state changes; decisions are reevaluated across alternatives.
Continuation distinguishes open-episode rehydration from closed-episode fork and requires fresh live-world inspection after resume.
Relational applicability is a deterministic fresh-world computation with all grounding and world/read provenance.
Dependency traversal is distinct from authority traversal; reachability does not create effective authority.
The broader assurance architecture composes separated portfolio, research, optimization, truth-maintenance, decision, procedure, capability, and tool-fabric roles.
Verification infrastructure distinguishes semantic kills from timeout, collection, infrastructure, baseline, and invalid-test/setup failures.
Continuation bundles preserve observable lineage and runtime compatibility while requiring current-world revalidation.
Mere existence of evidence is insufficient for a transition; usability requires integrity, scope, time, first-seen, and claim compatibility.
The durable architecture favors explicit authority boundaries and reusable lower-level primitives over monolithic authority.

open_questions.question: Define generic conversation discovery without hidden context.
Define formal semantic equivalence for stored/restored/rebuilt frontiers.
Define atomic publication and optimistic concurrency semantics for frontier revisions.
Prove a real cross-conversation restore at the actual conversation boundary.
Prove one canonical authority per semantic domain and no hidden shadow state.
Test multi-workstream continuation without cross-stream contamination.
Test coordinated tampering across manifest, capsule, HEAD, discovery, and integrity bindings.
Prove state is exactly reconstructible by reducing the revision event log.
Test concurrent forks and explicit merge semantics.
Test discovery ambiguity and stale HEAD/index behavior.
Determine the minimal generic frontier substrate for multiple semantic domains.
Ensure preserved opportunities and rejected paths survive revisions without becoming executable authority.
